sections.A: Shin splints (MTSS) mein pindli ki haddi ke andar ke kinare par exercise se dard hota hai. Load bohat zyada ho to yeh bone stress injury ya stress fracture tak ja sakta hai.
sections.B: MTSS mein dard lamba aur phaila hua hota hai, daurne ke shuru mein. Stress fracture mein ek jagah dard jo chalne aur raat ko bhi ho.
sections.C: Faasla, raftaar, zameen ya joote mein haal ki tabdeeli, aur kya chalne ya raat ko dard hota hai.
sections.D: Haddi ke saath ungliyan chala kar dabayein, aur single-leg hop test (10 hop).
sections.F: Stress fracture, compartment syndrome aur artery ka dabna isi jaise lag sakte hain.
sections.G: Ek jagah barhta dard, chalne aur raat ko dard (stress fracture), ya pindli ke aage high-risk jagah par dard: refer.
sections.H: Ek jagah dard, positive hop test ya high-risk jagah ho to bone stress injury samjhein, load kam karein aur imaging. Warna MTSS.
sections.I: Asal ilaaj load control hai: daurna dard-free level tak kam, cycling ya swimming se fitness, phir dheere dheere daurne par wapsi.
sections.M: Dard ke baghair hop ki ginti, dabane par dard, dard ke baghair daurne ka waqt aur heel raise dobara dekhein.
sections.N: Sawaal hal karein. MTSS mein dard lambe hisse par phaila hota hai, stress fracture mein ek jagah.
sections.now-you-should-be-able-to: Yeh checklist hai. Har point khud kar sakein to tick karein.
